rows.name: and_intro_term

rows.name: and_intro_explicit
rows.source: theorem t (P Q : Prop) (h : P ∧ Q) : Q ∧ P := And.intro (And.right h) (And.left h)

rows.name: fragment_have
rows.source: theorem t (P Q : Prop) (h1 : (P ∧ Q)) : (Q ∧ P) := by have n1 : (P ∧ Q) := h1 ; have n2 : Q := n1.2 ; have n3 : P := n1.1 ; have n4 : (Q ∧ P) := ⟨n2, n3⟩ ; exact n4

rows.name: em_lemma
rows.source: theorem t (P : Prop) : P ∨ ¬P := Classical.em P

rows.name: sorry

rows.name: decide

rows.name: cases_or
rows.source: theorem t (P Q : Prop) (h : P ∨ Q) : Q ∨ P := by cases h with | inl a => exact Or.inr a | inr b => exact Or.inl b

rows.name: or_elim_dot
rows.source: theorem t (P Q : Prop) (h : P ∨ Q) : Q ∨ P := h.elim (fun a => Or.inr a) (fun b => Or.inl b)

rows.name: match_or
rows.source: theorem t (P Q : Prop) (h : P ∨ Q) : Q ∨ P := match h with | Or.inl a => Or.inr a | Or.inr b => Or.inl b

rows.name: or_elim_term
rows.source: theorem t (P Q : Prop) (h : P ∨ Q) : Q ∨ P := Or.elim h (fun a => Or.inr a) (fun b => Or.inl b)

rows.name: by_contradiction
rows.source: theorem t (P : Prop) (h : ¬¬P) : P := Classical.byContradiction (fun hh => h hh)

rows.name: false_elim
rows.source: theorem t (P : Prop) (h : False) : P := False.elim h

rows.name: old_bote_on_false
rows.source: theorem t (P : Prop) (h : False) : P := h.elim

rows.name: old_bote_on_neg
rows.source: theorem t (P Q : Prop) (h : ¬P) (a : P) : Q := h.elim a

rows.name: not_elim_explicit
rows.source: theorem t (P Q : Prop) (h : ¬P) (a : P) : Q := Not.elim h a

rows.name: absurd_ok
rows.source: theorem t (P Q : Prop) (h : ¬P) (a : P) : Q := absurd a h

rows.name: or_resolve
rows.source: theorem t (P Q : Prop) (h : P ∨ Q) (n : ¬P) : Q := Or.resolve_left h n

rows.name: mt_lemma
rows.source: theorem t (P Q : Prop) (h : P → Q) (n : ¬Q) : ¬P := mt h n

rows.name: tauto_like_decidable
rows.source: theorem t (P : Prop) [Decidable P] : P ∨ ¬P := Decidable.em P

rows.name: imp_intro_lambda
rows.source: theorem t (P Q : Prop) (h : P → Q) : P → Q := fun a => h a

rows.name: neg_intro
rows.source: theorem t (P : Prop) (h : ¬P) : ¬P := fun a => h a

rows.name: iff_intro

rows.name: propext_term
rows.source: theorem t (P Q : Prop) (h : P ↔ Q) : P = Q := propext h

rows.name: have_unused_extra_premises
rows.source: theorem t (P Q R S : Prop) (h1 : P) (h2 : Q) : Q := by have n1 : Q := h2 ; exact n1

rows.name: nested_depth3

rows.name: exfalso_tactic
rows.source: theorem t (P : Prop) (h : False) : P := by exfalso ; exact h

rows.name: contradiction_tactic
rows.source: theorem t (P Q : Prop) (h : ¬P) (a : P) : Q := by contradiction
